Heritage & history Free

Friday 25 September, 10:00 – Sunday 27 September, 17:45

Sacred Treasures from Kyiv at the V&A

Seven Ukrainian Baroque sacred works from the Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra are shown in the UK for the first time, including an icon, altar Gospel and silver chalice.

Venue
V&A South Kensington
Address
Cromwell Road, London, SW7 2RL

Art & design Free

Friday 25 September, 11:00 – Sunday 27 September, 18:00

Reviving Craft at Somerset House

More than 70 artists trace China’s living craft heritage through ceramics, glass, textiles, jewellery, furniture and immersive digital work in the South Wing galleries.

Venue
Somerset House, Embankment Galleries South Wing
Address
Somerset House, Strand, London, WC2R 1LA
